enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom with fan on low and light off
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body still. Fan on low. Light off. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the university day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Turn off fan. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a flexitarian breakfast of porridge with fruit and a cup of tea, avoiding alcohol and caffeine-heavy drinks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open cupboard. Take out oats. Take out bowl. Pour oats into bowl. Open refrigerator. Take out fruit. Cut fruit. Add fruit to bowl. Pour water into bowl. Put bowl in microwave. Close microwave door. Press start button. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take tea bag from cupboard. Place tea bag in cup. Pour hot water into cup. Take bowl out of microwave. Stir porridge with spoon. Sit at table. Eat porridge with spoon. Drink tea. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study bag, checking the written timetable and reminders on the phone, and reviewing the weekly budget before leaving
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open study bag. Place notebooks in bag. Place laptop in bag. Place pens in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Check timetable. Open reminders app. Read reminders. Open budget app. Review budget. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk to door. Put on shoes. Open door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport (bus and train) towards the Monash Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on with Myki card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Pull cord to request stop. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap on. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Ride train. Arrive at station. Stand up. Walk to train door. Exit train. Walk to campus. Enter campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending full-time Master of Social Work lectures and coursework on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Open notebook. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand to ask question. Ask question. Listen to answer. Continue writing. Take out laptop. Open laptop. Type notes. Check phone for messages. Put phone away. Pack up at end. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed flexitarian lunch on campus and taking notes for the afternoon sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to campus cafeteria. Sit at table. Open bag. Take out packed lunch. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Open drink bottle. Drink water. Take out notebook. Review morning notes. Write additional notes. Check phone for reminders. Pack up lunch waste. Throw away trash. Stand up. Walk to next class.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending tutorials and completing library study for the social work coursework
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into tutorial room. Sit at table. Take out notebook. Participate in discussion. Raise hand. Speak. Listen to others. Write notes. Walk to library. Find study desk. Sit down. Open laptop. Open library website. Search for articles. Read articles. Take notes. Cite sources. Save document. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by public transport (bus and train) from campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on with Myki card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Pull cord to request stop. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap on. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Ride train. Arrive at station. Stand up. Walk to train door. Exit train. Walk to home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker and rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out tofu. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add tofu. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Open rice cooker. Scoop rice into bowl. Close rice cooker. Put food on plate. Walk to table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the shared kitchen table and drinking tea
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Pick up cup. Drink tea. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Walk back to table. Pick up cup. Walk to sink. Place cup in sink. Return to table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes, wiping the shared bench and tidying the kitchen space
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Wash cup. Rinse cup. Place cup in drying rack. Pick up cloth. Wipe bench. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off tap. Wipe stove. Put away ingredients. Close cupboard. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying at the desk with the desk lamp on, reading notes and writing assignments on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Read notes. Type on keyboard. Scroll through notes. Highlight text. Write paragraphs. Take a break. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Walk back. Sit down. Continue typing. Save document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and a light snack while checking written to-do reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Take tea bag. Place in cup. Open cupboard. Take out biscuits. Place biscuits on plate. Pour hot water into cup. Pick up plate and cup. Sit at kitchen table. Open planner. Read to-do list. Check off items. Drink tea. Eat biscuit. Close planner. Stand up. Wash cup and plate. Put away. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and running a small load of laundry in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Open washing machine. Put clothes in. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Set cycle. Press start. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting out clothes for the next day, writing tomorrow's schedule in the planner and checking reminders before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select clothes. Lay clothes on chair. Walk to desk. Open planner. Write schedule. Close planner. Pick up phone. Check reminders. Set alarm. Put phone on charge. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Walk to bedroom. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed and sleeping, keeping the room quiet and dark
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Remain asleep.
